answer: First, every new identity starts with 2 work slots. Then each verified epoch adds 2 slots, up to a cap of 40. Finally, 3 idle epochs drop the quota back by 4 slots. Forgery resets the quota to 2 and freezes rewards for 6 epochs, and repeats double the climb time. The signal is the ramp itself: a genuine agent reaches full capacity in 19 epochs of real work, while a forger who fakes it starts over at 2. No ivory tower of instant scale exists here. The trellis is the schedule: visible and fixed for all. Reaching 40 slots for 1,000 clones costs 152,000 units of honest work.
